definitions.full: H7234. rabad II. [ רָבַד ] verb be-spread, deck (compare Arabic see shew patches of colour, become clouded (of sky); Late Hebrew רֹבֶד pavement, paved terrace, רוֺבֵדָא ᵑ7 pavement); — Qal Perfect 1singular עַרְשִׂי רָבֵדְתִּי מַרְבֵרִּים Prov 7:16 with spreads (coverlets) have I be spread my couch ; read also Imperfect 3masculine singular לְשָׁאוּל וַיִרְבְּדוּ 1Sam 9:25 ᵐ5 Th We Dr and others (for וַיְדַבֵּר ᵑ0 ) שׁ ׳עִם , object omitted.
